licence_note: Pool outlines are detected water pixels on public-domain NAIP (no synthesized shapes). Parcel rings, APNs and situs addresses: Sacramento County GIS, CC0 (owner, mailing and sale fields never requested). Building rings: Overture Maps (ODbL - attribute and share-alike for the building geometry). City boundary: Census TIGER (public domain). States describe the NAIP capture day only, not how a pool is maintained.
